trajectory_input.altitude_assumption: reported altitude treated as geometric height; actual reference unknown
trajectory_input.clock_assumption: synthetic clock; source timezone does not align a real IMU
trajectory_input.interpolation: Natural C2 cubic within short observed intervals only; no provider estimates or long-gap bridging; development latent-path assumption

envelope_assumptions.nuisance_state: bounded north/east wind corners and drifts crossed with TAS levels/drifts
envelope_assumptions.weighting: fixed gyro noise 3 and 6 dph and conditional GNSS speed constraint; no gyro fit/residual weights
envelope_assumptions.limitations: Finite development grid, not a bound over every admissible nuisance trajectory

wind_tas_policy.evidence: Conditional GNSS speed constraint with latent smooth TAS; no independent heading or airspeed observation
wind_tas_policy.provenance: Provisional development assumptions; independent wind truth, calibration and hardware checks required

limitations: Selected adaptively after development timing screening; not independent evidence.
Only the registered finite physical-wind envelope and one partial comparison.
Broader wind fails nominal retention; physical wind/TAS assumptions still need justification.
Assumed interpolated geometry and supplied axes; no recovered-axis or full-pipeline certification.
No simulated flight, nonlinear fit, power, calibrated threshold or Earth-model decision.
